responsibility: Lowers Rust intrinsic calls for the GCC codegen backend by coordinating intrinsic dispatch, signature validation, and result construction across several lowering paths: the main entry point handles Rust intrinsics, libc mappings, custom shims, and builtin invocation; the LLVM bridge translates LLVM intrinsic names to GCC builtins and applies calling-signature compatibility fixups; the architecture table supplies generated fallback mappings for target-specific LLVM intrinsics not handled inline; and the SIMD lowering layer type-checks and codegens generic vector intrinsics into gccjit vector operations.
